test_title: PYST 9: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

This _________ a challenging time for us all.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the correct form of the verb is 'has been' which indicates that it has been a challenging time recently and continues to be so.
 
• The verb** 'has been**' is used with singular subjects and matches the context of the sentence.
 
• When describing an ongoing situation that started in the past and continues into the present, **the present perfect tense (has/have been) is used**
 
 
• Example: She **has been working **here for five years.
 
 

Hence, the correct statement is "**This has been__ a challenging time for us all.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The other options are incorrect:
 
 
• **'was been'** is grammatically** incorrect **as 'was' and 'been' cannot be used together.
 
• **'are'** is **incorrect **as it is a plural verb form.
 
• **'had being'** is grammatically** incorrect.**
